017package org.apache.commons.collections4.functors;
018
019import org.apache.commons.collections4.Predicate;
020
021/**
022 * Abstract base class for predicates.
023 *
024 * @param <T> the type of the input to the predicate.
025 * @since 4.5.0-M3
026 */
027public abstract class AbstractPredicate<T> implements Predicate<T> {
028
029    @Override
030    public boolean evaluate(final T object) {
031        return test(object);
032    }
033}
